correctness.rationale: The failure of the all-H2 synthesis is witnessed explicitly by square-summable coefficients whose Hankel output has a non-square-summable harmonic lower bound. The bounded multiplier identity was checked coefficientwise. The arbitrary-multiplicity common-shadow theorem follows from injectivity of each nonzero coefficient map on a minimal invariant subspace and an inner-multiplier contradiction using Beurling model spaces.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source asserts the all-H2 synthesis and does not identify the Hankel/BMOA obstruction or give the multiplier proof. Searches of the source identifier, title, backward-shift minimal invariant subspaces, coefficient maps, vector-valued Hardy spaces, and model-space formulations found no matching arbitrary-multiplicity common-shadow theorem. Classical Nehari and Beurling theory are treated as prior art.

value.rationale: The result separates a false analytic lemma from a valid geometric rigidity statement, gives a reusable explicit obstruction and exact classical boundedness boundary, and replaces the defective synthesis step by a shorter theorem valid for arbitrary Hilbert multiplicity and arbitrary coefficient directions.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
